{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.04

|gr1= Unit Inventory

|descr= Returns an array with the type names of all the unit's uniform magazines.

|s1= [[magazinesDetailUniform]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Array]] of [[String]]s

|s2= [[magazinesDetailUniform]] [unit, includeEmpty, includeLoaded]

|s2since= arma3 2.00

|p21= unit: [[Object]] - unit

|p22= includeEmpty: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[false]]) [[true]] to include empty magazines
|p23= includeLoaded: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[false]]) [[true]] to include magazines loaded in weapons (Since Arma 3 v2.07.148195)

|r2= [[Array]] of [[String]]s

|x1= <sqf>
magazinesDetailUniform player;
/*
[
	"6.5 mm 30Rnd Sand Mag(30/30)[id/cr:10000003/0]",
	"Chemlight (Green)(1/1)[id/cr:10000020/0]"
]
*/
</sqf>

|seealso= [[magazinesDetail]] [[magazinesDetailVest]] [[magazinesDetailBackpack]]
}}

{{Note
|user= Leopard20
|timestamp= 20210912220751
|text= To return the ammo count in each magazine, you can use this code:
<sqf>
magazinesDetailUniform player apply {
	private _reverse = reverse _x;
	private_i1 = (_reverse find "[)") + 1;
	private_i2 = (_reverse find ["/", _id1]) + 1;
	private_i3 = _reverse find ["(", _id2];
	parseNumber reverse (_reverse select [_i2, _i3 - _i2]); // return cnt
};
</sqf>
}}
